# Paired MI follow-up: validation in progress

The external-imputation interface has passed the local regression suite (1699
expectations), and all 14 tutorials rebuild. The original 820-row manuscript
candidate baseline is unchanged. Local source-archive checking with --as-cran
--no-manual found 0 errors, 0 warnings and 2 environment/development-version notes.

The paired statistical study is still running. No final coverage claim is made
here. The protocol and reproducible scripts are in this directory; the completed
results and uncertainty will replace this status once all planned repetitions
and the separately identified m=20 sensitivity analysis finish.

Passing software tests is not evidence of nominal coverage for every imputation
model. The new interface does not certify supplied imputations as compatible.
